_comment_crons: Daily, deliberately. Vercel's Hobby (free) plan allows at most one cron run
per day and FAILS THE DEPLOYMENT outright for any expression that would run
more often - '0 */4 * * *' is rejected with 'Hobby accounts are limited to
daily cron jobs'. For a more frequent refresh either upgrade to Pro and
change this to '0 */4 * * *', or use .github/workflows/ingest.yml, which
pings this same endpoint every 4 hours from GitHub Actions at no cost.
The minute is off the hour on purpose: Hobby cron timing is +/-59 minutes
